spatial.reading: Each band is a strip of whole rows (row_bands) or whole columns (col_bands) of the window grid, numbered from 0: row band 0 holds row 0, the grid's first rows, and column band 0 holds column 0; the scores carry no georeference (no window locations or transform), so the rows need not run north to south and no band is a compass direction. share_of_differing is the band's share of ALL differing windows; share_of_windows is its share of all compared windows, the share an even spread would give it; share_of_band_differing is the share of the band's own windows that differ. top_band_share is row band 0's share_of_differing; max_band is the band, of either axis, holding the most differing windows.

content:
Comparison done via `olmoearth_compare_review` on the two score files.

**Where they differ** (maps 216 days apart):

| | |
|---|---|
| Windows compared | 78,028 |
| Differing | 1,570 (2.0%) |
| Not water (A) → water (B) | 1,247 (79.4% of differences) |
| Water (A) → not water (B) | 323 (20.6%) |
| Most confident side | A on 77.6% of differing windows (margin alone does not make it right) |
| Concentration | Rows 2,800-4,199 (middle of the 5,600-row grid) hold 46.8% of the differing windows |

All 1,570 differing windows are listed in `compare_differing_eec2555155.json` (in workspace), each with both classes and margins.

**Which is right: not answerable from this comparison.** The maps describe different times, so a differing window either changed on the ground between Sep 2017 and Apr 2018 or one map is wrong there - and neither fact can tell which. No recorded experiment grades these two maps, and this tool takes no labels. To settle it, each map needs its own dated reference: labels for the 2017-09-14/15 period grade only map A, labels for 2018-04-19 grade only map B. If you have such references (or want a plan for spending N labels per map), I can use `olmoearth_plan_label_sample` / `olmoearth_estimate_map_error` next.
